Subject: RFI: Marketplace procurement — technical & compliance evidence for Acme Health

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at Acme Health is preparing our marketplace procurement packet for vendor approval and we need a concise set of answers and evidence for acceptance across AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplaces. Can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday?

- Confirm Redwood's marketplace publishing status for AWS / Azure / GCP and provide publisher/offer IDs.
- List required steps and expected timelines for a private offer (AWS Private Catalog / Azure Private Offer / GCP Private Pricing).
- Provide the pro forma billing flow for subscription vs metered usage and whether you support direct invoicing / PO.
- Provide links or copies for security artifacts: SOC 2 Type II, ISO27001 (if available), DPA template.
- State data residency and encryption guarantees for marketplace customers and any region restrictions.
- Point of contact for contract/legal redlines and DocuSign links if you have an MSA ready.

We prefer a compact package (single-page checklist + attachments). Attaching our internal procurement checklist — happy to schedule a quick 20-min sync if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena — thanks, and great to connect. Attached is a concise packet we put together for marketplace procurement teams. Highlights below and attachments are included.

Attachment: redwood_marketplace_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet: publishing status, timelines, docs list)
Attachment: marketplace_procurement_answers_v1.pdf (one-page answers + links)
Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2025.pdf (evidence)

Quick answers:
- Publishing status: Hosted listing (AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, GCP Marketplace) — offer IDs and links included in the PDF. We are fully listed on AWS and Azure; GCP listing is active but private-offer capability requires partner registration (see timeline).
- Private offers: typical lead time is 7–12 business days once paperwork is in (AWS/Azure). GCP often requires partner onboarding + 5–10 business days. See checklist for required fields (tax info, seller ID, publisher attestation).
- Billing: We support both subscription (monthly commit) and metered billing via AWS Marketplace Metering Service. For Azure and GCP we can accept Marketplace metered models or issue direct invoices on enterprise contracts — PO accepted.
- Data residency & encryption: Customer workloads may be pinned to region-specific deployments for Dedicated or Private. Hosted redwood endpoints are region-tagged; data at rest encrypted with AES-256, TLS1.2+ in transit. DPA included in the PDF.
- Legal & redlines: please route contract redlines to contracts@redwood.ai. We can send a pre-signed MSA via DocuSign to fast-track. DocuSign link included below.

Next steps I propose:
1) We send the MSA + DPA via DocuSign (link below).
2) You confirm whether Acme needs a private offer or standard marketplace billing.
3) If private offer, we'll loop in Partner Ops and provide the Seller/Publisher IDs and a mutual action plan.

Links: DocuSign MSA https://docusign.net/envelope/123-REDWOOD-ACME | HubSpot ACME record https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/ACME

If helpful, I can jump on a 20-min call tomorrow morning to walk through the checklist — otherwise we’ll await the DocuSign/PO instruction.

Best,

Vanessa — quick notes from Partner Ops:

- GCP: Partner registration required (Partner Advantage). We need Acme to sign the private offer paperwork and Redwood must be an approved partner. If Acme is the buyer with a private pricing arrangement, GCP requires us to register the private offer and associate buyer project IDs. Expect 7–10 business days for the partner verification + private offer activation once paperwork is submitted.
- Billing: GCP private offers can support both metered and one-time invoice models; most enterprise customers request direct invoicing under a commercial contract. That requires our billing team to set buyer invoicing terms — add 5 business days for billing connector setup.
- Gotchas: GCP requires precise SKU mapping for metered products; our runtime team (quantization/profile SKUs) needs to confirm usage units to avoid mismatch.

I'll draft the partner onboarding packet and share the exact list of fields needed from Acme (seller IDs, tax forms, project numbers).

—Aditya

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-04T16:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFI: Marketplace procurement — Acme Health (action items)

Vanessa / Aditya — pricing & finance notes:

- If Acme opts for a subscription via AWS Marketplace (monthly committed), we can bill through marketplace metering or provide direct invoicing on an enterprise contract. For private offers with direct invoicing, expect the procurement group to issue a PO; we can map that to a monthly invoice cadence.
- Lead time: finance needs PO + signed MSA to set up invoicing (3–5 business days). If Acme requires VAT reverse-charge (EU billing), we'll need their VAT ID and billing address at contract time.
- Recommendation: propose a 60-day soft-launch via marketplace metered model to start ingestion, then move to private-offer direct invoicing for production (this reduces initial billing friction).

I can provide a short paragraph for the procurement packet about invoice cadence and tax handling if you want — I’ll draft and send it shortly.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
